title: Fallback book ceiling is now 0.15 while the featured path keeps 0.12
detail: The featured exact-name collector (scripts/domain.py MAX_SPREAD = 0.12) is unchanged. The origination ladder, which only runs when the featured method produced no pick, now accepts a two-sided exchange book up to 0.15 and marks anything wider than 0.12 as thin. The production case is Infinite vs Insiders (fixture 1081526): Polymarket books were Infinite 0.75/0.88 and Insiders Esport 0.12/0.25 (spread 0.13) at the 2026-10-18T00:53Z snapshot, just above the old featured ceiling, while Kalshi's book was 0.22 wide and still rejects. The accepted 0.13 book is published with the explicit thin-market limitation. Books wider than 0.15 remain rejected and never become a pick; no featured probability is widened or replaced by this rule.

title: Valve name 6666 joined to ex-6666 on a 4-of-5 roster overlap (manual review)
detail: The Valve 2026-10-05 global table lists '6666' at standing 127 with 923 points and the five-player roster amster, dENZY, kL1o, rendysky, skcH. HLTV lists the same competition slot as 'ex-6666' vs 'Privateer' with the lineup skcH, kL1o, amster, rendysky, stefienson. Four of five players match; Valve's dENZY is replaced by stefienson in the current HLTV lineup. The scoped alias in data/origination/aliases.json therefore supports identity, not an exact current five-player roster. It feeds the labelled, uncalibrated Valve model cross-check. The displayed pick for this fixture comes from the fresh, reviewed EGamersWorld bookmaker-average capture (1.13 / 4.75), explicitly labelled a third-party aggregation; the alias never joins or alters that price. Manual review requested.

title: Two fixtures remain blank; antidaun depends on a dated third-party capture
detail: After the merged ladder (first-party books and esportsbooks, the reviewed EGamersWorld aggregation, then the Valve model) two fixtures still have no defensible pick. Lynn Vision vs Morningstar: no Polymarket/Kalshi/Thunderpick/Bovada line, Morningstar has no global/Europe/Americas/Asia Valve row, and the EGamersWorld page carries only the site's 1.8/1.8 placeholder with no bookmaker-average sentence. Chinggis Warriors vs WXM: the same absence, WXM has no Valve row, and Chinggis has two complete rows whose current five cannot be proven. Both stay blank with no default 50/50. antidaun vs Phantom Academy is no longer blank only because a reviewed EGamersWorld capture (5.345 / 1.115, observed 2026-10-18T00:10:45Z) supplies an aggregated average; its Polymarket and Kalshi books remain 0.41 wide and are never used. That capture is fresh for eight hours, so the fixture can return to the blank list when it ages out unless a new capture is reviewed. ex-6666, Infinite vs Insiders and aimclub vs BASEMENT BOYS now resolve through the alias, the widened 0.13 fallback book and the reviewed reference/roster paths respectively.

title: Day-5 final-day leans rechecked against both Polymarket event pages
detail: The final-day summary now shows the two snapshot leans directly. At 2026-10-18T00:20Z the Polymarket series pages priced Team Falcons 61% / Aurora Gaming 40% (normalized 60.5% / 39.5%) for the 11:30 UTC third-place decider, and FURIA 71% / BetBoom Team 30% (normalized 70.8% / 29.2%) for the 15:00 UTC BO5 grand final. The page labels them as snapshot leans, not confirmed picks, because these are HLTV-listed tournament fixtures whose Hotspawn entry and lock are unverified. Prices can move before the matches.

title: Coverage and summary pages count different tiers (featured vs complete)
detail: The coverage page's 'Future probabilities' figure counts only the featured exact-name method (8 of 17 at the 2026-10-18T00:53Z snapshot). The executive summary and the complete-picks list count the researched fallback ladder too (11 of 17 at that snapshot, before the 6666 identity join and the 0.13-book fallback are applied by a fresh live run). Both figures are correct for their scope, but reading them side by side can look contradictory. The executive summary now states its figures as external-line and research-model counts and links both lists; the coverage page keeps the featured-only label.

title: A unique four-of-five HLTV core now disambiguates duplicate Valve rows
detail: aimclub vs BASEMENT BOYS had two complete 'aimclub' rows in the 2026-10-05 global standings (standing 77 with ERSIN, mhN1, ragga, waZz, zewts; standing 336 with Ed1m, ERSIN, RoberttMP, XELLOW, zewts). HLTV match 2399591 publishes aimclub as ragga, waZz, mhN1, zewts, XELLOW: four of five match standing 77, one current player differs (ERSIN replaced by XELLOW), and only two of five match standing 336. The fallback now accepts a *unique* four-of-five core as a roster-change identity join, labels the row as historical rather than current-lineup, and adds an explicit limitation. Two plausible four-of-five rows, a three-of-five overlap, or an unbound/stale lineup still fail closed. The same rule is covered by tests against archived real fixtures (BET-M and aimclub); no probability or price is invented. In the live 2026-10-18 snapshot the reviewed EGamersWorld capture resolves aimclub first, so the four-of-five model is a cross-check there; it remains the fallback for a duplicate-name fixture with no reference capture.
